title.narrative: Madagascar Youth Skills for Economic Transformation and Jobs Project

description.narrative: In this project, skills development extends beyond TVET and professional training to encompass the professional higher education sector and on-the-job training. To build a high-value-added economy, a diverse range of skills is needed across the entire value chain. Consequently, this project will take an inter-ministerial approach, focusing on skills development at multiple levels, from lower-level skills to higher-level skills. The project will be national in scope with prioritized location to be determined by appraisal and subject to completion of a needs assessment and targeting analysis.
Increase the number of graduates with skills needed to access jobs in priority sectors.
